resources.string: Reads on-screen text while Spotify is open to detect when an ad is playing, and attempts to tap the Skip/Next control if one is available. Never touches Spotify\'s own audio stream or network traffic. Optionally (off by default) requests audio focus to pause/duck Spotify\'s own playback during an ad, and can optionally play music from a folder you choose during that time instead of silence - see the app\'s README for details.
